L.description: inside length of the floor, upstream end wall to overflow sill

H.description: side and upstream end wall height above the floor

h_s.description: overflow sill height above the floor (full width, downstream end)

x_n.description: nozzle exit centre: distance from the upstream end wall

y_n.description: nozzle exit centre: distance from the side wall (centre plane)

z_n.description: nozzle exit centre: height above the floor

L_n.description: nozzle straight length (bore length upstream of the exit)

theta.description: jet angle below the horizontal, pointing downstream (+x)

h_0.description: initial liquid depth (still liquid up to the sill crest)
